subject: Greenline Health — initial admin provisioning and API key seed plan
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@greenline.health>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Greenline — initial admin provisioning and API key seed plan

Alex — great to meet earlier in the kickoff. Per our call, I want to lock down the immediate admin list and propose a lightweight timeline for API key seeding so your engineers can begin smoke tests before the data cutover.

High-level asks: 
- Confirm 2-3 admin users for initial workspace (company-admin role).
- Confirm whether you want service accounts for ingestion pipelines (we can seed project-level API keys).
- Any SSO requirement (SAML/Okta) before we invite non-admin users? If so, we’ll hold invites until that’s configured.

Proposed schedule (attached): 
- Day 0 (this week): Seed two admin accounts + one service API key in sandbox project.
- Day 2: Customer runs smoke tests and reports token usage/connectivity.
- Day 5: Seed remaining API keys and invite product engineers.

Attachments: greenline-admin-roles-template.csv (CSV role mapping), api-seed-schedule.xlsx (one-page schedule)

Next steps: If you can reply with the names and emails of the two admins, I’ll seed immediately and share the API key handoff notes. Monica will own the key rotation guidance and Ben will coordinate the project naming and quota settings.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@greenline.health>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@greenline.health
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Greenline — initial admin provisioning and API key seed plan

Thanks Vanessa — this looks good.

We can confirm two initial admins: 
- Priya Shah <priya.shah@greenline.health> (Head of Product)
- Mark Ellison <mark.ellison@greenline.health> (Platform Lead)

We do want service accounts for ingestion pipelines. Please seed one service account key under project name gln-ingest-sandbox.

SSO: we are planning an Okta rollout next week. For the first smoke tests, please proceed with invites using temporary passwords for the two admins and the service key. We’ll switch to SSO post-setup.

Procurement is cc’d for any contract-level notes; they may follow up separately about the order of dedicated seats.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

— Alex
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@greenline.health>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Greenline — initial admin provisioning and API key seed plan

Thanks Alex — tagging in the exact role mapping we’ll use. I’ve attached a CSV template in the original email; below is the mapping I’ll apply to the two admins and the service account.

Role mapping (summary):
- company-admin: full workspace admin + billing visibility — assign to Priya Shah
- project-admin: project-level config and API key rotation — assign to Mark Ellison
- service-account: scoped to gln-ingest-sandbox, token expiry 90 days, rotation recommended every 30 days for CI pipelines

Seeding plan (I’ll do the seeding once Vanessa confirms):
1) Create sandbox project gln-ingest-sandbox (Ben)
2) Seed a service-account API key and upload key metadata to the secure handoff doc (Vanessa)
3) Create user accounts for Priya and Mark with temporary passwords (Vanessa)
4) Share encrypted key/first-login instructions over the Drive link and mark the HubSpot timeline for follow-up

Notes: If Greenline prefers HSM-backed KMS for the service key, flag here and we’ll open an engineering request. For now we’ll use standard KMS with rotation hooks.

Monica Patel
Implementation Lead, Redwood Inference

Subject: Provisioning complete — sandbox keys + next actions

Alex — quick update: we seeded the sandbox project and completed the initial handoff. Summary below and action items.

What we did (completed):
- Project created: gln-ingest-sandbox
- Service account key seeded: gln-service-ingest-key-1 (expires 2026-11-24) — key material uploaded to secure Drive (link below)
- User accounts created: Priya Shah, Mark Ellison — temporary passwords sent via encrypted note
- Role assignments: Priya (company-admin), Mark (project-admin)

Attachments: greenline-admin-roles-template.csv, api-seed-schedule.xlsx

Open items / next actions:
- Alex: confirm that Mark can access the project and run the smoke curl tests by EOD Friday (28 Aug).
- Vanessa: schedule a 30-minute walkthrough with Mark and your SRE to validate token usage and rotate the first key (suggested Wed 2026-09-01).
- Monica: raise HSM request in engineering backlog if Greenline wants hardware-backed KMS for production keys.

Links: Secure handoff doc: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1A2bGreenlineKickoff
HubSpot: HS-439201

If you’re good with the above, I’ll mark the kickoff task as done and move the onboarding to the next phase (invite product engineers and expand quotas).

Thanks everyone — small win.

Vanessa Ortiz
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
